## Overview

The final session is dedicated to completing and submitting your data project. We also take stock of what we have learned across the semester and look at where to go next on your R journey.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `13-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [13-content.zip](/files/projects/13-content.zip)
